mapper.sql: m.id, m.training_id, m.user_id, m.student_snapshot, m.class_snapshot, m.signup_at, m.status, m.review_by, m.review_at, m.reject_reason, m.complete_result, m.complete_date, m.cert_no, m.cert_issue_date, m.cert_valid_until, m.note, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.username) AS user_name, u.student_id AS student_no, t.training_name AS training_name

FROM party_training_member m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = m.user_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN party_training t ON t.id = m.training_id AND t.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO party_training_member (training_id, user_id, student_snapshot, class_snapshot, signup_at, status, review_by, review_at, reject_reason, complete_result, complete_date, cert_no, cert_issue_date, cert_valid_until, note, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{trainingId}, #{userId}, #{studentSnapshot}, #{classSnapshot}, #{signupAt}, #{status}, #{reviewBy}, #{reviewAt}, #{rejectReason}, #{completeResult}, #{completeDate}, #{certNo}, #{certIssueDate}, #{certValidUntil}, #{note}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE m.training_id = #{trainingId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE party_training_member SET status = #{toStatus}, review_by = #{reviewBy}, review_at = #{reviewAt}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE party_training_member SET status = 'completed', complete_result = #{completeResult}, complete_date = #{completeDate}, cert_no = #{certNo}, cert_issue_date = #{certIssueDate}, cert_valid_until = #{certValidUntil}, note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE party_training_member SET cert_no = #{certNo}, cert_issue_date = #{certIssueDate}, cert_valid_until = #{certValidUntil}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'completed'
mapper.select: SELECT m.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM party_training_member m WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.training_id = #{trainingId} GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY m.status
SELECT m.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM party_training_member m WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY m.status
